scenarios.title: SCN-0 environment warm-up (not a scenario): compile every route the walkthrough touches so the dev server's first-hit 404 cannot masquerade as a product failure
SCN-1.1 setup: the setup wizard offers only Medal Marks for an adjudicated Country competition (no callbacks option)
SCN-1.3 W4/K1 callback-target readiness blocker: 'Callback target not set' blocks readiness until the organizer sets a target
scenarios.note: No UI path creates a callback_tally round (wizard studio_custom@3 offers only Medal Marks; Advanced round form has no callback_tally).

scenarios.title: SCN-1.2 setup: owner creates the schedule competition, adds a second division, publishes and opens registration
SCN-0b environment warm-up with the real event (not a scenario): the event layout must pass before the dev server compiles a page below it
SCN-2.1 registration: three buyers pay for four entries with a test card (Avery dances two entries); the Entries page shows them paid
SCN-2.2 eligibility: an ineligible entry is excluded from the schedule; the Schedule page counts the rest
SCN-3.1 generate heats: Avery's two entries land in different heats; no competitor is double-booked; a conflicting move is refused in the UI
SCN-3.2 capacity: a per-division heat size of 2 applies when heats are regenerated with all four entries
SCN-3.3 editing the draft: move a heat, add an empty heat, remove it; numbering stays contiguous
SCN-3.4 publish: the running order is published, survives a reload and is visible to a second manager
SCN-3.5 reschedule: edit the published running order into a draft copy, move a heat, republish; exactly one version is in effect
SCN-5.1 officials: unverified judges cannot be added; after verifying their email the owner adds three, names a chair and builds the panel to 'Panel ready'
SCN-5.2 a judge sees only their own assignment; a non-official instructor sees none; neither can open the competition workspace
SCN-7.1 day-of: schedule and start the round; floor heats move waiting -> on deck -> on the floor -> done, and survive a reload
SCN-6.1 scratch in an open heat: no payment changes, the entry leaves the heat, the day-of console no longer lists it
SCN-6.2 a danced heat refuses the scratch: the page explains why, offers no scratch button, and nothing is written
SCN-6.3a locking prerequisite: the ballot desk for the wizard's Final round says ballots are not available and Lock ballots stays disabled
SCN-6.3 official scratch in a locked heat: the reason is required, the heat stays locked, one audit row
scenarios.note: No UI path to a locked heat: ballots for the wizard's 'custom' Final round are unavailable, and heats lock only when ballots lock.

scenarios.title: SCN-10.1 no-show: an official marks an entry in the active heat as no-show with a reason; the floor console shows it
SCN-10.5 judge ballot page: the no-show entry is not on the judge's sheet, with a note; ballot submission itself is blocked by the setup-scoring gap
scenarios.note: PASS for the note and the missing entry; ballot submission is BLOCKED by the setup-scoring gap (wizard rounds are 'custom').

scenarios.title: SCN-10.3 a staff member who is not an official is refused: console pages are closed to them and a direct call is rejected; nothing is written
SCN-10.2 void: the official undoes the no-show with a reason; the entry is back, the mark stays as history, the judge note is gone
SCN-10.7 the chair marks a no-show on the ballot desk (reason required); a non-chair judge has no No-shows panel; the mark is attributed to the chair
SCN-10.6 a different studio gets a 404 on the floor console and the judge ballot page and cannot record a no-show
SCN-10.4 after ballots lock, marking a no-show is refused
scenarios.note: Marking after ballots lock needs locked ballots, which the 'custom' wizard round cannot reach via the UI (same gap as SCN-6.3).

scenarios.title: SCN-7.2 day-of: cancel a round with a reason; the empty Bronze Open round shows Cancelled and stays cancelled after a reload
SCN-8.1 access matrix: owner and admin manage; front desk is sent to check-in; instructor, judge and another studio get 404; anonymous is sent to login
SCN-8.2 database authorization: another studio and an anonymous caller read no heats and cannot list officials; a judge's own assignments come back as theirs only
SCN-9 database integrity: one version in effect, contiguous heat numbers, no double-booked dancer, every scratch audited, no payment moved by a scratch
SCN-4.1 heat-level judge assignment: assign a different judge to one heat of a round
scenarios.note: Panels are per round; no per-heat judge assignment UI.

scenarios.title: SCN-4.2 instructor-to-heat assignment: assign an instructor to a heat and see an instructor conflict
SCN-4.3 a real conflict banner: the running order cannot be published while a heat has a shared competitor
scenarios.note: No UI path creates a shared-competitor heat (planner avoids it; the move option is disabled).
